# Zone-key contract

Zone keys are lowercase. Ignore leading and trailing whitespace and replace
one or more internal whitespace characters with one hyphen. Preserve existing
hyphens and digits. The CLI and shipment labels must share this behavior.

Four public behavior cases define the workshop acceptance examples:

1. CLI manifest for " North\tDock " has zone_key "north-dock".
2. canonical_zone(" East \n Gate ") returns "east-gate".
3. zone_label(" West  Wing ") returns "zone:west-wing".
4. CLI manifest for " SOUTH-2 " keeps zone_key "south-2".

The examples are not exhaustive proof for every possible string. Inputs in
this exercise are strings. Keep the CLI command and JSON field names stable.
---
./routekit/labels.py
./routekit/manifest.py
./routekit/__init__.py
./routekit/cli.py
./routekit/zones.py
./tests/test_zones.py
./tests/__init__.py
./tests/test_labels.py
./tests/test_cli.py
